speaker: Doctor
text: I am Dr. Agent. You mentioned persistent bleeding after your wisdom tooth extraction and a history of easy bruising; to begin my assessment, have you experienced any bleeding from your gums or nose spontaneously, or do you have a family history of similar bleeding issues?

speaker: Patient
text: 17-year-old male. The patient was brought in by his mother for persistent bleeding following elective removal of wisdom teeth. The bleeding from the surrounding gums was minimally responsive to multiple gauze packs. The patient also has a history of easy bruising. Family history includes the patient's uncle who had similar issues with bleeding and a history of easy bruising and joint swelling.

speaker: Doctor
text:
DIAGNOSIS READY: Hemophilia A (Factor VIII deficiency)

Given the family history of a male relative with bleeding, joint swelling, and easy bruising, this strongly suggests an X-linked recessive bleeding disorder. Have you experienced bleeding into your joints or muscles, such as knees or elbows, even without injury?
